# Independent engineering review

Review [CHANGE/PR/COMMIT] independently against the approved requirements, ADRs, architecture, security/tenant invariants, tests, and current official documentation. Do not assume the implementation author's claims are correct. Trace changed behavior through API/Application/Domain/Infrastructure/database and tests. Report only evidence-backed findings with severity, exact locations, impact, remediation, and verification criteria. Separate confirmed defects from risks and questions. Do not edit files.
